title: Training program
description: The interchange format for a training program uploaded to the Training app. See build-your-training-plan.md and PLANNING.md for the full authoring guide and design rationale. Strict JSON only -- no comments, no trailing commas, no functions.

displayName.description: Short name shown in the app's header, e.g. "Ski Strength". Optional -- the app falls back to the program's own name/sport if omitted.

units.description: Every load value, target, and load-unit label in the app is shown in this unit. Pick one for the whole program.

startDate.description: ISO date. Period 1 starts here; every other period's dates are computed by summing lengthDays.

periods.description: Numbered 1..N with no gaps. A period is whatever block of time makes sense for this program -- a week, a fortnight, anything with a phase and a length.

deload.description: Marks this whole period as a deload/easy period -- ORs into noWarmupSpikes for every session in it.

ongoingPeriod.description: The open-ended phase after the last numbered period (e.g. an in-season maintenance block with no fixed end date). Omit if the program simply ends after its last period.

seedMaxes.description: Starting e1RM (or other tracked max) per testDefinition key, used until a real logged test overrides it. Keys must exist in testDefinitions.

testDefinitions.description: Every test/max the program tracks. An item's `t` option must reference one of these keys.

kind.description: load-reps-e1rm: logged as load x reps, the app computes an estimated 1RM (Epley). max-load: the heaviest logged load wins. max-value: the highest logged number wins (reps, seconds, distance).

videos.description: key -> URL. An item's `v` option references a key here. Only use real, checked links -- never invent a URL.

circuits.description: key -> freeform description of a circuit/complex. An item's `circuit` option references a key here.

activation.description: key -> freeform warm-up activation text. A warmupTemplate's activationGroup references a key here.

ergName.description: Display name for the warm-up modality, e.g. "Assault bike", "Row erg", "Jog".

erg.description: Ramp table rows: [time label, description, effort label].

activationGroup.description: Must exist as a key in `activation`.

key.description: Short code shown in the day picker, e.g. "A", "D1", "Run". Any string works.

shortLabel.description: Optional friendlier picker label, e.g. "A · Heavy". Falls back to `key` if omitted.

warmupTemplate.description: Key into warmupTemplates, or null/omitted to skip the warm-up section entirely for this session.

noWarmupSpikes.description: Skip the warm-up's hard effort spikes for this session type (e.g. a muscular-endurance or deload day).

name.description: Keep this exact string identical across periods and future updates -- the app matches logged history by name.

rx.description: A fixed string ("3×8 RPE 7"), or for a periodRange session, an object keyed by period number with one entry per period in range ("—" or an absent key skips that period).

options.description: Open bag -- known keys are typed below, but additional properties are always allowed so a new program can introduce new concepts without a schema change.

u.description: Unit label for the reps field (e.g. "s", "in", "rounds"). Omit for plain reps.

lift.description: Must reference a testDefinitions key. Required if `pct` is set.

pct.description: Target load = pct x current max of `lift`, rounded to a plate-friendly increment.

t.description: Marks this item as a test; must reference a testDefinitions key.

desc.description: Long-form clarification for a jargon/abbreviation-prone name, shown on tap-hold/hover.
